name: TAK-653
summary: Osavampator (developmental code names TAK-653 and NBI-1065845) is an experimental drug being investigated as a treatment for treatment-resistant depression.). Takeda Pharmaceuticals discovered the molecule originally, and holds exclusive right to market the drug in Japan, while Neurocrine Biosciences holds the right to market it to the rest of the world.

pharmacology.text: Osavampator is a selective positive allosteric modulator (PAM) of the AMPA receptor. Osavampator and other AMPA PAMs potentiate the effects of agonists at the main site of the AMPA receptor by slowing the rate of desensitization and internalization of the receptor.

uses.text: Osavampator (developmental code names TAK-653 and NBI-1065845) is an experimental drug being investigated as a treatment for treatment-resistant depression. It is being developed by Neurocrine Biosciences and Takeda Pharmaceuticals (Millennium Pharmaceuticals, Inc.).

sideEffects.en: It is still experimental, so its side effects are not well known. Strong AMPA boosters as a class can cause seizures in animals.
sideEffects.zh: 它仍在試驗階段，副作用目前所知不多。作用強的AMPA增強劑這一類藥物在動物身上可能引發癲癇。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它仍在试验阶段，副作用目前所知不多。作用强的AMPA增强剂这一类药物在动物身上可能引发癫痫。

fact.en: It boosts AMPA receptors, the glutamate receptors whose activation is thought to help explain the fast antidepressant effect of ketamine.
fact.zh: 它會增強AMPA受體的作用，而AMPA這類麩胺酸受體的活化，被認為有助於解釋K他命快速抗憂鬱的效果。
fact.zhHans: 它会增强AMPA受体的作用，而AMPA这类麸胺酸受体的活化，被认为有助于解释K他命快速抗忧郁的效果。
